protocol_version.description: Intent protocol version used by this repository.

required.description: Set true only when repository policy requires human approval for every change.

authorized_reviewers.description: Reviewer identities for repository-defined approval gates; the list may be empty when no approval gate is configured.

protected_paths.description: Path globs whose existing files may not change unless the change declares them.

verify_command.description: Repository verification command; an empty string disables automatic runs.

require_baseline.description: Set true to require a passing baseline run at the change's base revision.

warn_unused_paths.description: Warn when a declared scope path matches no changed file.

record_exempt_paths.description: Path globs a change may touch without carrying a record (documentation and the Intent bundle by default).
